description: Delete a Worker script by name. Requires confirm:true (human-approval gate); without it returns a preview only.

account_id.description: Cloudflare account ID. Falls back to CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID env var when omitted.

confirm.description: Human-approval gate: must be true to actually perform this mutating operation. Omit or set false to get a non-executing preview of what would happen (with secrets redacted). A human should approve before this is set to true.

script_name.description: The Worker script name to delete.

name: delete_worker
